title: Base Language Model Clients
summary: This module defines the foundational `BaseLM` class for all DSPy language models, along with concrete implementations for local and cloud-based (Databricks, OpenAI) LM providers, including support for finetuning and deployment.

nodes.label: BaseLM
nodes.title: BaseLM Class
nodes.description: The abstract base class for all DSPy language models, defining the core interface for interacting with LMs, including synchronous and asynchronous calls, history tracking, and state management.

nodes.label: LocalProvider
nodes.title: Local Model Provider
nodes.description: Manages the launching, finetuning, and killing of local language models, typically using SGLang for server management.

nodes.label: tokenize_function
nodes.title: Tokenization Utility
nodes.description: A utility function used by LocalProvider for tokenizing data during local finetuning processes.

nodes.label: DatabricksProvider
nodes.title: Databricks Model Provider
nodes.description: Handles finetuning and deployment of models on the Databricks platform, including managing serving endpoints and data uploads to Unity Catalog.

nodes.label: TrainingJobDatabricks
nodes.title: Databricks Training Job
nodes.description: Represents a finetuning job on Databricks, tracking its status and deployment details.

nodes.label: TrainingJobOpenAI
nodes.title: OpenAI Training Job
nodes.description: Manages finetuning jobs with OpenAI, providing methods to cancel jobs and track their status.

nodes.label: LM API Interaction
nodes.title: LM API Interaction Module
nodes.description: Handles the actual communication with various language model APIs, including LiteLLM for completions and streaming.

nodes.label: Caching and Utilities
nodes.title: Caching and Utilities Module
nodes.description: Provides caching mechanisms and other utility functions for language model interactions.

groups.label: Core LM Interface
groups.title: Core Language Model Interface
groups.description: Defines the fundamental interface and behavior for all language models within DSPy.

groups.label: Local LM Management
groups.title: Local Language Model Management
groups.description: Components responsible for launching, finetuning, and managing language models running locally.

groups.label: Cloud LM Providers
groups.title: Cloud Language Model Providers
groups.description: Implementations for interacting with and managing language models hosted on cloud platforms like Databricks and OpenAI.
